list.title: Data Aggregator
list.subTitle: A Data Aggregator is a feature that enables structured notification handling after a Connection is triggered in a Schedule. When a Schedule executes a Connection, the Aggregator processes the execution data and prepares it for notification delivery (e.g., via <ntLink>Notification Templates</ntLink>).
